requirements.text: Synchronous active-high reset: on a rising edge with rst = 1, y becomes 0 and sat becomes 0.
y and sat are registered: they show the result for the x and g sampled at the previous rising edge (latency 1 cycle).
The product of two Q1.7 values is formed at full precision before any rounding: 127 x 127 gives y = 0x7e (126/128) with sat = 0.
A result above the Q1.7 maximum saturates: y = 0x7f and sat = 1 for that cycle (-1 x -1 = +1 gives 0x7f). sat is 0 whenever the result fits.
The 14 fractional bits of the product are truncated to 7 by dropping the 7 LSBs (arithmetic shift: toward minus infinity, never rounded, never toward zero).
x and g are two's complement signed Q1.7; the result is correct in all four sign combinations.
